title: Snow Safety Check Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=snow:safety
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(checklist_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many snow safety check events land each day and how many distinct checklist values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest snow safety check records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct checklist values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much snow safety check activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
